name: Timeline
intent: What happened on a record, newest first: a circled icon per entry joined by a line, with the note, links and action for each one.
usage: Use Timeline for the activity on a record: calls, emails, notes, status changes, an audit trail. It is one component: pass items as data. Each item has a title, and optional timestamp, subtitle, icon, intent, notes, links and one action, plus a More menu of kit Dropdown entries. The line joins the entries and stops at the last one. Keep the order you want to show, usually newest first. For steps in a flow, use Steps. For a list of records, use Table. See contracts/timeline.json for the full contract.

itemShape.title: string
itemShape.timestamp: string? Small line above the title, like 2 hours ago or 8 Jan 2027, 14:02.
itemShape.subtitle: string? One line under the title, like who did it.
itemShape.icon: string? Material Symbols name. Default history.
itemShape.intent: neutral | brand | success | warning | danger? Tints the circle. Default neutral.
itemShape.notes: string? The body text under the head.
itemShape.links: { label, href?, onClick? }[]? Related records, one per line.
itemShape.action: { label, onClick? }? One secondary Button under the entry.
itemShape.menu: DropdownMenuEntry[]? A More menu at the end of the head.

items.note: One entry per thing that happened, in the order they are shown.

size.note: md has a 44 circle; sm has a 32 circle and smaller text, for Drawers and side panels.

label.note: Name of the list for screen readers, like Account activity.

onMenuSelect.note: A pick from an entry's More menu: the entry's id, then the menu item's id.

useWhen: The activity on a record: calls, emails, notes, status changes.
An audit trail of what changed and when.
A history panel in a Drawer beside a record.
doNot: Do not build a feed from your own divs, or add a TimelineItem, ActivityCard or FeedRow. Pass items.
Do not use it for steps in a flow. Use Steps.
Do not use it for a list of records people sort and filter. Use Table.
Do not put more than one action on an entry; extra ones go in the More menu.
a11y: An ordered list with a label, so the number of entries is read.
The circles and the line are hidden from screen readers; the entry's text carries the meaning.
Links are real links when they have an href, and buttons when they do not.
Each More menu is named after its entry, like Actions for Call with Maya Chen.
